budget.title: Company budget
budget.description: Manage the fiscal-year budget your events draw from.
budget.emptyDesc: Create and activate a fiscal-year budget with at least one category before submitting events.
budget.validationTotal: Enter a valid total amount greater than zero.

budget.categoriesRequired: Add at least one budget category.
budget.categoriesInvalid: Each category needs a name and an amount greater than zero.
budget.categoriesExceedTotal: Category amounts cannot exceed the total budget.
budget.unallocatedHint: Available to create or grow categories
budget.noCategoriesRequired: Add at least one category — events cannot be created without one.
budget.cannotDeleteLastCategory: At least one category is required.

budget.categoryReturned: Returned {amount} to the company budget and deleted the category.
budget.categoryUnusedReturned: Returned {amount} unused funds to the company budget.
budget.confirmDelete: Delete this budget? Draft/rejected/cancelled events on it will also be removed. Pending or approved events must be cleared first.

events.description: Draft corporate events, allocate budget, and submit for approval.
events.emptyDesc: Create an event and allocate budget from the company FY budget.
events.newEventDesc: Allocate budget, capture requirements, and invite collaborators — then plan venues and vendors.

events.needBudgetDesc: Ask a finance approver or owner to create and activate a fiscal-year budget first.

events.editFlowHint: Changes apply while the event is still a draft or after rejection.
events.sectionBasicsDesc: Name the event and describe what you need.
events.sectionBudgetDesc: Draw from the company fiscal-year budget.
events.sectionScheduleDesc: Optional planning fields for approvers and vendors.
events.sectionTeamDesc: You’re the lead. Add collaborators from your organization.
events.requirementsPlaceholder: Venue capacity, AV, catering, accessibility, overnight stays…
events.objectivesPlaceholder: What should this event achieve for the business?
events.categoryBudgetExhausted: “{category}” has no remaining budget. Raise its allocation on the Budget page, free committed events, or pick another category.
events.submitHint: Add at least one venue or marketplace service, then submit. Approvers will review against the company budget.
events.draftSaved: Draft saved. Add venues or services, then submit.
events.cannotEditDesc: Only draft or rejected events can be edited by the owner or creator.
events.leadHint: Automatically assigned when you create or update this event.
events.noTeamMembers: No other active teammates yet. Invite people from Team, then come back.
events.validationTitle: Title must be at least 3 characters.
events.validationAmount: Enter a valid allocation greater than zero.
events.validationDateRange: End date must be on or after the start date.
events.validationAttendees: Attendees must be a whole number of at least 1.

events.noPlannedResources: No venues or vendor services added yet. Browse the catalog and attach selections to this event.

events.allBookedHint: Every planned item is reserved. Open Reserve to review or release a hold.
events.confirmBookingsHint: After approval you can still change a venue or service if a slot is gone. Holding a venue or instant-book service locks the slot for 7 days. Most marketplace vendors do not offer instant booking — those become a request they must accept. Finance or an owner then pays to confirm.
events.confirmAllHint: Same as Hold this slot, for every ready item. Pay later to confirm.
events.confirmNoPermission: Only owners and event managers can hold slots.
events.chooseSlotHint: Pick the window to book. Taken windows are greyed out.
events.noSlotsOnDate: No time slots published for this date.

events.lineHeldHint: Slot held. Finance or an owner must pay within 7 days to confirm.
events.paymentDueHint: Slots are held. An owner or finance approver pays with a company card on the Pay tab.
events.paymentPaidHint: Company payment is settled and these bookings are confirmed.
events.paymentPartialHint: Partially paid — finish the remaining currency charges to confirm every hold.
events.payNoPermission: Only an owner or finance approver can settle payment.
events.confirmPay: Settle company payment for the held bookings? This confirms them with the vendors.
events.lineBookedHint: Booked and confirmed with the vendor.
events.lineRequestedHint: Request sent. Open Requests to see the vendor’s quote when it arrives.
events.confirmRelease: Release this booking? The slot goes back on sale and the vendor is notified.
events.addToEventRoleHint: Only owners and event managers can plan event resources.
events.noDraftEvents: Create a draft event first to attach this resource.
events.noCountriesConfigured: No countries are available yet. Ask an admin to configure locations.
events.noCitiesConfigured: No cities are available for this country yet.

events.validationLocation: Select a city from the list.
events.chatHint: Group chat with each vendor after payment. Owners, the event manager, and collaborators are in the thread.
events.chatInboxHint: One thread per paid venue or service.

events.chatSelect: Select a vendor to start chatting.
events.chatNoMessages: No messages yet. Say hello to the vendor.

events.requestsHint: Inquiry-only marketplace services wait here until the vendor sends a quote. Accept the quote to hold it, then pay.
events.noRequests: No vendor requests on this event yet. Send a request from Reserve.
events.requestsNoPermission: Only owners and event managers can accept or decline quotes.
events.quoteExceedsEstimate: This quote is higher than your line estimate.
events.quoteExceedsAllocation: This quote is higher than the event’s budget allocation. You can still accept; finance will see the total on Pay.
events.declineReasonPrompt: Optional note for the vendor (or leave blank):
events.waitingVendorHint: Request sent. The vendor will send a proposal here — you don’t need the consumer inbox.
events.quoteHeldHint: Quote accepted and held. An owner or finance approver can pay on the Pay tab.
events.payHint: Pay held venues and accepted quotes with a saved company card. Each vendor is charged in their own currency.
events.payExceedsAllocation: Due {due} is above this event’s allocation of {allocated}. Payment still goes through if you continue.

events.payChargeHintMulti: Choose a company card. We charge each vendor currency separately, then confirm those holds.
events.nothingToPay: Nothing is held for payment yet. Reserve a slot or accept a quote first.
events.payChargeHint: Choose a company card. Paying confirms the held bookings with the vendors.
events.payNoCardHint: Save a company card to pay this event.

events.needCardToPay: Add a company card first, then pay.
events.stripeNotConfigured: Stripe is not configured in this app. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.
events.cardsNoPermission: Only an owner or finance approver can manage company cards.
